name: application-data-filter-bar
title: Data Filter Bar
description: Horizontal bar of active-filter chips with per-chip removal, a clear-all control, and an "Add filter" trigger — the applied-filters layer that sits above a filter picker for tables, lists, and search results.
useWhen: Showing which filters are currently applied to a table, list, or search result set.
Users need to remove one filter at a time or clear all filters in a single action.
Pairing with a filter picker (dropdown, combobox, or panel) that adds new chips via onAddFilter.
avoidWhen: You only have a single filter or sort control — a plain select or the base application-filters component is simpler.
Filters need their own always-visible controls (not just a summary chip) — use a filter panel or the filters component's inline fields instead.
There is no active-filter state to summarize — this component has nothing to show until at least one filter is applied.
responsiveBehavior: The bar wraps chips onto multiple lines on narrow viewports rather than truncating or scrolling; the Add filter and Clear all controls remain reachable at every width.
accessibility: Active filters are grouped in a role='list' with role='listitem' chips so screen readers announce the count and each filter.
Each chip's remove button has an aria-label naming the specific filter being removed, not just 'Remove'.
Add filter and Clear all are real buttons reachable by keyboard, with visible focus rings.

variants.title: Data filter bar
variants.description: Three active-filter chips with remove buttons, an Add filter trigger, and a Clear all action on a light surface.
accessibility: Chip color is supplementary; the filter label text and remove-button aria-label carry the meaning.

variants.title: Data filter bar (Dark)
variants.description: Three active-filter chips with remove buttons, an Add filter trigger, and a Clear all action, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Chip background and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
